metadata.name: paycheck_router
metadata.description: Routes each paycheck's USDC into tokenized stocks under an onchain price guard

accounts.name: owner_source
docs: The owner's pre-IPO token account; the Convert authority is its delegate.

accounts.name: destination
docs: The owner's account for the conversion target.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: verification level, feed and age are checked in the handler.

accounts.name: owner_asset
docs: The owner's account for the asset: destination on a buy, source on a sell.

errors.name: ConfigPaused
errors.msg: Protocol is paused

errors.name: RouterPaused
errors.msg: Router is paused

errors.name: InvalidWeights
errors.msg: Leg weights must be positive, unique and sum to 10,000 bps

errors.name: TooManyLegs
errors.msg: Too many legs

errors.name: BandTooWide
errors.msg: Band exceeds the allowed cap

errors.name: AssetNotActive
errors.msg: Asset is not active

errors.name: AssetKindMismatch
errors.msg: Asset kind does not match this instruction

errors.name: NoNewInflow
errors.msg: No new inflow above the watermark

errors.name: InflowBelowMinimum
errors.msg: Inflow is below the router minimum

errors.name: UnauthorizedRecorder
errors.msg: Signer is not the router's recorder

errors.name: LegNotPending
errors.msg: Leg is not pending

errors.name: PaycheckExpired
errors.msg: Paycheck has expired

errors.name: PriceStale
errors.msg: Price is stale

errors.name: PriceFeedMismatch
errors.msg: Price account does not match the expected feed

errors.name: ConfidenceTooWide
errors.msg: Price confidence interval is too wide

errors.name: UsdcDepeg
errors.msg: USDC is off its peg

errors.name: AllowanceInsufficient
errors.msg: Delegated allowance does not cover the leg

errors.name: DelegateMismatch
errors.msg: Router authority is not the token account delegate

errors.name: BalanceInsufficient
errors.msg: Balance does not cover the leg

errors.name: DestinationOwnerMismatch
errors.msg: Destination is not owned by the router owner

errors.name: DestinationMintMismatch
errors.msg: Destination mint does not match the asset

errors.name: JupiterProgramMismatch
errors.msg: Swap program is not the allowlisted Jupiter program

errors.name: OutputBelowMinimum
errors.msg: Swap delivered less than the guarded minimum

errors.name: InputOverspent
errors.msg: Swap moved a different input amount than the leg

errors.name: AttestationMissing
errors.msg: Ed25519 attestation instruction is missing

errors.name: AttestationSignerMismatch
errors.msg: Attestation is not signed by the configured attester

errors.name: AttestationStale
errors.msg: Attestation is too old

errors.name: AttestationMalformed
errors.msg: Attestation instruction or message is malformed

errors.name: ConversionNotActive
errors.msg: Asset is not converting

errors.name: ConversionDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: Conversion deadline has passed

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: OpenPaychecksRemain
errors.msg: Router still has open paycheck legs

errors.name: InvalidParameter
errors.msg: Parameter outside its allowed range

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not allowed to perform this action

errors.name: LegNotExpired
errors.msg: Leg has not reached its expiry

fields.name: amount_in
docs: USDC base units for a buy, raw asset units for a sell.

fields.name: out_amount
docs: Shares the owner's account gained, net of any issuer transfer fee.

fields.name: issuer_fee
docs: Issuer transfer fee withheld in the destination (Token-2022
TransferFeeConfig mints such as PreStocks); zero otherwise.

types.name: MarkAttestation
docs: Signed PreStocks mark carried by the Ed25519 instruction in front of
`execute_prestock_leg`. The attester signs its Borsh serialization.

types.name: PriceSource
docs: Where a guard's reference price came from.

fields.name: pending_legs
docs: Legs across all paychecks still in Pending; close_router needs zero.
